title: jubilant creamy australian rigatoni pasta
description: a rich and velvety pasta dish featuring the bold flavors of australian cuisine, with a comforting and satisfying twist.
instructions: cook the rigatoni pasta according to the package instructions until al dente, then drain and set aside.
in a large hot pot vessel, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
add the butter to the hot pot vessel and stir until melted and frothy.
add the chopped onion to the hot pot vessel and cook until softened and translucent, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic to the hot pot vessel and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
add the Australian aboriginal bush tomato relish to the hot pot vessel and stir to combine.
add the cooked rigatoni pasta to the hot pot vessel and toss to combine with the sauce.
stir in the grated gruyere cheese until melted and smooth.
reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 minutes, allowing the sauce to thicken.
stir in the heavy cream and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until heated through.
season with salt and black pepper to taste, then serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley and dill.
